assessment_objectives.objective: the organization governs a process by which employees return all organizational assets in their possession within an organization-defined period following termination of employment.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 5 business days following termination

assessment_objectives.objective: the organization governs a process by which third-party users return all organizational assets in their possession within an organization-defined period following termination of the contract or agreement.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: no more than 5 business days following termination of the contract or agreement

assessment_objectives.objective: upon termination of individual employment, security-related system property is retrieved.
